limitations: Starts at first container timestamp; initial tool launch before that timestamp is not captured.
Ends before final-answer generation and delivery; those durations are not measured.
Web windows combine API/server/network and orchestration time; pure network time is not exposed.
Residual combines reasoning, reading, drafting, code preparation, and unisolated tool/startup overhead; it is not pure reasoning time.
All tool calls lie within this interval apart from the initial pre-timestamp launch and final report/archive-tail write.
Worker elapsed times overlap and are not added to wall-clock totals.
